searchText: We could really use an "official" maintainer of the EIP Ruby code: <https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/3787> By "official" here I just mean someone that we generally trust to review code and ensure that things generally work and someone isn't injecting security vulnerabilities into the page. > - This PR requires review from one of [<@!301186049323958275>zoltu, <@!543900561460822016>, @arachnid, <@!256103085099712512>, @souptacular, <@!273808422753796097>, @nicksavers, @wanderer, @axic] Did I get kicked off the list of editors? Or did the bot get smart enough to not let me merge my own PRs? <@!683653554631868440> would need to ask <@!104006934562107392>, but i see that you are regularly tagged by the bot otherwise so my guess is that the bot is smart enough to no allow you to merge your own PRs 🙂 OK, thanks. And while I have your attention -- https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/3789 There was *also* some discussion about cleaning up the editor list, though from the rest of the names on that list I don't think that is the cause. yea that's in progress! can add you <@!683653554631868440> but also you shouldn't be able to merge your own PRs that require editor approval that's a feature so that editors need review from other editors I used to be a ruby junkie if you need help still i thought it was the greatest until i discovered nodejs 😏 You mean until TypeScript... right? Right? <@!301186049323958275> Gemfile changes look fine, and the added dependencies are due to Nokogiri changing the way it manages its dependencies. Do you have a desire to help with the Ruby side of things long term? We don't need to touch it often, but it would be nice to have someone to deal with PRs like this and the GitHub security alert stuff. Don’t mind, if someone can walk me through the current setup quickly I’m good with that This is exactly the problem, I don't think anyone who is around knows the setup. 😬 Hahahaha ok. I’ll investigate it I’ll document the flow
